{{Warning|SIMK41 and SIMK43 pinouts are different! Using the wrong ECM or harness will result in '''damage to your vehicle'''! Use at your own risk. Verify the type of ECM and harness before proceeding.}}

Male Socket: TE 1746979-1 121 Pin Socket

Female Plug: TE 368290-1 or 368376-1 81 Pin Plug
